label: Regentonmeter-node_Node-RED
info: Managing the data from iot_node to mariadb_database/Node-RED_dashboard

name: Unifier TTNV3
MYSQL insert to my database
template:
INSERT INTO device
(
    device_id,
    device_eui
)
VALUES
(
    "{{payload.devID}}",
    "{{payload.devEUI}}"
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
device_id = VALUES(device_id);

INSERT INTO measurement
(
    device_id,
    uplink_at,
    battery_voltage_cv,
    flow_volume_ml,
    level_cm
)
SELECT
    id,
    "{{payload.datetime}}",
    {{payload.batteryVoltage}},
    {{payload.flowMeter}},
    {{payload.levelMeter}}
FROM device
WHERE device_eui = "{{payload.devEUI}}";

name: Pre Process
Gateways
func:
let queries = [];

for (const gw of msg.payload.radioMetadata) {

    queries.push(`
        INSERT INTO radio_metadata
        (
            measurement_id,
            gateway_name,
            gateway_eui,
            rssi,
            snr,
            latitude,
            longitude,
            height
        )
        SELECT
            m.id,
            '${gw.gateway_name}',
            '${gw.gateway_eui}',
            ${gw.rssi},
            ${gw.snr},
            ${gw.latitude},
            ${gw.longitude},
            ${gw.height}
        FROM measurement m
        JOIN device d
            ON d.id = m.device_id
        WHERE d.device_eui = '${msg.payload.devEUI}'
        ORDER BY m.id DESC
        LIMIT 1;
    `);
}

msg.topic = queries.join("\n");

return msg;
